data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of prior year reserves of $267.9m in 2023, driven by significant releases in MAP Risks, Specialty Risks, Property and Digital divisions, partially offset by a strengthening on Cyber. Separately, a refinement to reserving methodology (including risk margin and claims handling expense provisioning) produced an additional net release of $64.7m. The amounts reported in the managing agent narrative are net of reinsurance; no single gross prior-year movement figure was provided in the narrative.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (insurance liabilities column) was presented in a single 'movement in prior years' note. The managing agent's statement 'released prior year reserves of $267.9m' and the division table are explicit but described as net releases; therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m above uses the reported NET figure (USD) and is flagged accordingly. A gross claims development triangle is present (gross amounts) and was extracted; a gross PYD could be calculated from that triangle as an alternative cross-check, but parsing the triangle to derive a single gross PYD was not used as the report narrative explicitly stated net releases. Line-of-business mapping from the managing agent's division names to the standard Lloyd's LOBs required judgement (e.g. 'Digital' -> 'Professional Lines', 'MAP Risks' -> 'Marine', 'Specialty Risks' -> 'Reinsurance - Specialty') and these mappings have lower confidence.
